objective: Turn a shopping candidate's physical envelope and ownership burden into an explicit measured-fit question at a HOUSE address without creating a new store, planner or authority.
delta: Shopping candidate records may carry BODY/OPERATING W/D/H, mass, maintenance and dependency burden.
Shopping → HOUSE transports only a session-local house-shopping-fit/v0.1 projection.
Canonical /house/ asks for real available W/D/H at the currently selected address and screens the operating envelope, including optional 90-degree rotation.
RETURN lands on the exact Shopping item through /shopping/#<item-id>.
/house/spatial/ remains a compatibility redirect and is not revived.

authority.shopping: candidate identity, purchase lifecycle, cost, burden and adoption evidence
authority.house: spatial address and local fit measurement context
authority.retained_boundary: No handoff purchases, promotes ownership, mutates canonical HOUSE geometry or actuates HA/HOUSEBUS.

residue: Doorway/path, service hookups, ventilation, load, cat clearance and installation constraints remain outside the envelope screen.
Recovered-donor/current-instance geometry uncertainty remains unchanged; fit uses explicit user-measured zone W/D/H rather than deriving dimensions from donor geometry.
